owner_input.owner_notes: Revision 2: expand into how people without grid power/running water historically and currently treat water; named examples rather than generic Africa; investigate Indian copper storage; why water practices differ globally; frequency/energy effects on water; and evidence concerning lunar effects on humans.
owner_input.requested_angle: lost knowledge, global practices, mechanism, evidence, practical application

websites_reviewed: https://academy.rebelranchministries.org (direct retrieval attempted; repository README used for current hub direction when retrieval failed)
context_review.learning_area_reason: Water systems, resourcefulness, sustainability and practical independence are core Sustainability & Agriculture subjects; evidence-literacy transfers across RRA.

conflicts_found: Lunar-human sleep literature contains positive studies and direct non-replication/publication-bias concerns.
Visible acoustic patterns and molecular frequency responses demonstrate effects while not establishing permanent beneficial restructuring of ordinary drinking water.
Traditional water practices document use; efficacy varies by mechanism, preparation and conditions.
unresolved_questions: Final visual production may reveal additional source needs for specific diagrams.

concept.learning_outcome: Compare global/traditional water practices, identify mechanisms, distinguish practice from demonstrated efficacy, evaluate copper/frequency/lunar claims at the evidence level they earned, and apply the same evidence discipline elsewhere.
concept.central_question: What is the water problem — and what evidence shows this method actually solves it?
major_principles: Water treatment is a chain, not a magic ingredient.
Traditional and modern describe context, not truth value.
Local source, climate, fuel, materials and infrastructure shape water systems.
A real mechanism does not make a method universal.
Observation, mechanism, correlation, causation and health benefit are different levels of claim.
Prove only what the evidence proves.
concept.historical_or_lost_knowledge_angle: Recover whole-system water knowledge and named regional practices without romanticizing unsafe history.
concept.current_use_angle: Use current experiments to test older practices and modern claims, including copper, Moringa, acoustics/frequency and lunar-human research.
concept.transfer_the_principle_summary: Match the claim to the mechanism and the evidence; respect observation without skipping the steps needed to establish causation or a practical recommendation.

pricing.role: paid core field guide with free public evidence-literacy sample

owner_review.latest_comment: Expand global/traditional water practices, copper, frequency/energy and lunar-human evidence.
